tests.name: Admin connects an agent with read and draft scopes
tests.when: CreateAgentConnection(workspaceId=ws-1, name=Triage Copilot, scopes=[read_conversations, draft_reply], createdBy=admin-1)
then: AgentConnectionCreated(connectionId=conn-1, workspaceId=ws-1, name=Triage Copilot, scopes=[read_conversations, draft_reply], createdBy=admin-1)

slices.name: Project Connection Summary
read_models: AgentConnectionSummary*(*workspaceId, connectionId, name, scopes, status, revokedBy)

slices.name: View Agent Connections
read_models: AgentConnectionSummary*(*workspaceId, connectionId, name, scopes, status, revokedBy)
slices.note: Status and scopes shown here are what the admin's kill switch and any support/security review acts on.

tests.name: Admin revokes a connection immediately
given: AgentConnectionCreated(connectionId=conn-1, workspaceId=ws-1, name=Triage Copilot, scopes=[read_conversations, draft_reply], createdBy=admin-1)

slices.name: Agent Reads Conversation
slices.note: Authorized against the calling connection's stored scopes from AgentConnectionSummary before the read reaches this read model. ConversationContext itself is projected by Front's existing conversation system, out of scope for this model.

slices.name: Agent Drafts Reply
slices.note: Requires the draft_reply scope on the calling connection, checked against AgentConnectionSummary.

tests.name: Agent drafts a reply for an open conversation
tests.when: DraftReply(conversationId=conv-9, connectionId=conn-1, bodyText=Thanks for reaching out, checking on this now.)
then: ReplyDrafted(conversationId=conv-9, draftId=draft-1, connectionId=conn-1, bodyText=Thanks for reaching out, checking on this now., draftedAt=2026-09-17T10:00:00Z)

slices.name: Project Draft Status
read_models: ConversationDraft(conversationId, draftId, bodyText, connectionId, draftedAt, status, finalText, sentBy, sentAt)

slices.name: Rep Views Draft
read_models: ConversationDraft(conversationId, draftId, bodyText, connectionId, draftedAt, status, finalText, sentBy, sentAt)

slices.name: Rep Sends Reply
slices.note: The agent never sends to the customer directly. Every send is this command, issued by a human rep, whether the text is untouched or fully rewritten.

tests.name: Rep sends the drafted reply unedited
given: ReplyDrafted(conversationId=conv-9, draftId=draft-1, connectionId=conn-1, bodyText=Thanks for reaching out, checking on this now., draftedAt=2026-09-17T10:00:00Z)
tests.when: SendReply(conversationId=conv-9, draftId=draft-1, finalText=Thanks for reaching out, checking on this now., sentBy=rep-4)
then: ReplySent(conversationId=conv-9, draftId=draft-1, finalText=Thanks for reaching out, checking on this now., sentBy=rep-4, sentAt=2026-09-17T10:02:00Z)

slices.name: Log Agent Action
slices.note: Every scoped agent action gets one audit entry, not just drafts; this slice shows the pattern for one action type.
